operations.name: onboarding.complete
operations.description: Create the company from the onboarding wizard answers and seed the vocabulary pack, module activation, Journey steps, starter metrics, and the default meeting ritual. Fails with 409 if a company already exists.

focus.description: JSON array of focus areas chosen in the wizard

operations.name: journey.autocheck
operations.description: Mark data-detectable Journey steps done (e.g. first customer exists, first sale recorded). Returns the titles of newly completed steps.

operations.name: stage.recompute
operations.description: Compute the suggested company stage from real records. When it differs from the current stage an open suggestion card is created; nothing is applied.

operations.name: stage.advance
operations.description: Apply a user-confirmed stage change: sets the company stage, unlocks that stage's Journey steps, and marks newly recommended modules as suggestions.

operations.name: workflows.run
operations.description: Run one built-in workflow: weekly_digest (writes a Weekly review note), journey_autocheck, stage_check, or attention_sweep (opens suggestion cards for overdue follow-ups and low runway). Every run is recorded in workflow_runs.

operations.name: ai.draft-plan
operations.description: Draft the EMPTY fields of the one-page plan (mission, who we serve, offer, how we make money) from the onboarding answers via the CraftBot bridge. Draft-only; returns 503 when no AI is available.

operations.name: marketing.ai_campaign_ideas
operations.description: Suggest 3 concrete low-cost campaign ideas for a funnel goal, from the company profile and active channels, via the CraftBot LLM. Suggestions only; returns 503 when no AI is available.

goal.description: Funnel goal the ideas should target

operations.name: marketing.ai_content_draft
operations.description: Draft copy for one content piece (post, email, ad, article, event) from its title/format and the company profile via the CraftBot LLM. Saves onto the content note when a promoId is given and its note is empty. Returns 503 when no AI is available.

promoId.description: Optional id of the promos record to draft for and save onto
